title: Weightlifter · Level 1: Lift 50 g
brief: Lift the claw's payload from the arm's lower stop (-30 deg) to +45 deg (within 3 deg) and hold it there 2 s without stalling (a stall counts from the arm leaving its stop: homing against the stop is free). Ten runs, each with a payload of 40 to 60 g the program is not told; you choose the gear (1, 1/2, 1/3, 1/4 or 1/5) in Configure robot. Per run: 50 for a good lift + 40 x min(1, 1.5 s / t) + 10 if it never stalled after leaving the stop, t from leaving the stop (above -29 deg) to first reaching +42 deg. Pass: a mean of 60 and at least 8 good lifts.

score.run: if(good, round(50 + 40 * min(1, par / liftS) + if(stalled, 0, 10), 1), 0)
